advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Fix docs/README.md:185 so the screen-presence finding (write persisted, about Epic Link) is not lumped in as an 'accept-and-ignore parent trap' — only the sub-task reparent is accept-and-ignore.
evidence: docs/README.md:185: "and the two accept-and-ignore parent traps (a sub-task reparent returns 204 and does nothing; screen presence does not gate REST writes)"
docs/jira-dc-capability-map.md:63: "`{\"fields\":{\"customfield_10001\":\"SCRUM-1\"}}` still returned **204 and round-tripped** on read-back" — the write PERSISTED, not ignored
docs/jira-dc-capability-map.md:70-74: the sub-task reparent is the only true accept-and-ignore case (204 then still parented to original)
docs/jira-dc-capability-map.md:61: the screen-gating note is about `Epic Link`, not the parent field
advisory.finding: The README index summary mischaracterizes the screen-gating finding: it groups it with the sub-task reparent as one of 'two accept-and-ignore parent traps', but the source doc says that PUT 'returned 204 and round-tripped on read-back' (the write PERSISTED), which is the opposite of accept-and-ignore; it also concerns `Epic Link` (customfield_10001), not the parent field, so 'parent trap' is doubly inaccurate.
advisory.suggested_fix: Reword to e.g. "…and the two findings that most defy the natural inference: a sub-task reparent returns 204 and silently drops the write, and screen presence does NOT gate REST writes (an off-screen Epic Link PUT still persists)."
